decision_rationale: The record describes a new generative foundation model, MUPAD, for multimodal histopathology rather than a review or wrapper. It clearly includes biological data and a substantive text-histology bridge through clinical text and text-image caption pairs.
evidence_snippet: "embeds hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained histology, molecular RNA profiles, and clinical text into a shared latent space"; "1.6 million descriptive histopathological caption-image pairs"; "supports text-conditioned... generation"
